vocabulary_tumor_stage.title: Tx: Primary Tumor, cannot be assessed
Tis: Non-invasive Carcinoma in situ (DCIS, LCIS, Paget's without tumor)
T4: Invades chest wall or skin, or inflammatory
T4c: Invades both skin + chest wall

vocabulary_nodes_stage.title: NX: Nodes cannot be assessed (e.g., previously removed)
N1: 1–3 axillary lymph nodes or small internal mammary nodes
N1b: Cancer cells in internal mammary sentinel nodes
N1c: 1–3 axillary nodes + internal mammary sentinel nodes
N2: 4–9 axillary nodes or internal mammary nodes without axillary nodes
N2b: Internal mammary nodes only (no axillary)
N3: 10+ axillary, infraclavicular, or supraclavicular nodes; or both axillary + internal mammary
N3a: ≥10 axillary nodes (≥2 mm) or infraclavicular

vocabulary_distant_metastasis_stage.title: M0(i+): No metastasis on scans, but cancer cells found in blood/bone marrow/distant nodes

representation_decisions.decision: Keep CancerBot ancestry/race categories distinct from the PRomop Hispanic/Latino ethnicity picker; reconcile the legacy Ethnicity lookup without merging Person race and ethnicity.
Keep count and >2 comparator separate from presence; do not equate source counts with Yes/No.
Retain CancerBot seven and PRomop eight GELF criteria with threshold conflicts explicit; aggregate is separate. Retain five FLIPI inputs, numeric score and risk separately.
Retain tumor, system, edition and c/p/yp basis. Imaging modality is a separate event.

representation_decisions.decision: Keep disease and staging system in identity; legacy I–IV has unresolved system, never infer R-ISS.
Use frozen Genomics findings/components; retain gene, variant, origin, interpretation, polarity and independent results.
Retain disease/response system and event; MRD and response categories may require separate observations (#253).
Reuse regimen/component/class and disease/round links; preserve planned versus administered status.
Use existing descriptor categories and formulas; retain compatibility aliases and no-concept administrative representations.
Preserve distinct typed source keys; missing or cleared values never become selected Unknown.
